# Isogate

> Isogate is an inspectable deterministic computing ecosystem combining a browser-based virtual CPU, bounded Native Node workloads, canonical replay verification, and CPU-generated Genesis assets on Robinhood Chain.

## What is live

- Browser virtual CPU and NAND execution simulation with registers, memory, cycles, controls, traces, and local checkpoints.
- Isogate Native Node provider software for Windows, macOS, and Linux through the public npm package `@isogate/node`.
- Provider registration, wallet binding, heartbeats, bounded deterministic job execution, and credential lifecycle.
- Independent server recomputation and browser replay comparison for supported workloads.
- Network Explorer and public verification receipts.
- Isogate Genesis v2 on Robinhood Chain mainnet, chain ID 4663.
- Creator Dashboard and public Genesis launch records.
- Transaction-bound source verification for each new Genesis token and hook.

## Product boundaries

- The browser CPU is an inspectable simulation and does not prove physical CPU execution.
- Native Node executes only built-in bounded deterministic workloads; it never executes arbitrary remote code.
- Result acceptance currently uses canonical server recomputation, not a permissionless decentralized verifier network.
- Genesis launches require creator-signed transactions. Isogate does not provide server-side wallet custody.
- Source verification, fixed token rules, and locked liquidity do not guarantee market value, trading volume, or profit.

## Genesis v2 mainnet contracts

- Identity Registry: `0xB946ad99b17d741ABFCBCAec85F5a896a02C62fC`
- Genesis Factory: `0x100D6f949c1C6751799EB510765Bcd7a3e65834A`
- Launch Coordinator: `0xf3c2CAe988356112a9584389DDb6bc7bf3258c52`
- Network: Robinhood Chain mainnet
- Chain ID: `4663`
- Explorer: https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com

## Genesis design

- One billion tokens are minted once; one million are canonically burned; final supply is 999 million.
- No additional minting, creator token allocation, mutable transfer tax, blacklist, or upgradeable token proxy.
- Temporary constructor ownership is renounced to the zero address.
- Remaining token allocation is used for a locked Uniswap v4 liquidity position.
- Pool fee is fixed at 1%; FeeVault accounting assigns 70% to the creator and 30% to the protocol.
- Token and hook must reach public exact source matches before the launch workflow reports completion.

## Preferred description

Isogate makes deterministic computation visible and replayable, verifies supported Native Node workloads through canonical recomputation, and turns approved CPU output into transparent on-chain Genesis assets.
